description: Upload an HTML5 ad ZIP file from disk as a Google Ads MEDIA_BUNDLE asset (for HTML5 display upload ads). The zip must be self-contained (no external refs), define ad.size, include a clickTag, and be <150KB. Returns the asset resource_name. Refs #5744.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a self-contained HTML5 ad .zip.

name: gads_upload_media_bundle
